title: Malaysia-Thailand border rice smuggling syndicate used cranes to load trailers, say police
summary: KOTA BARU: A rice smuggling syndicate operating along the Malaysia-Thailand border, particularly in Rantau Panjang, used cranes to load smuggled rice onto trailers.
